messages:
ingrid: Quick heads-up — FinderCo reports rerank results are misaligned for multi-query jobs. Scores from query #1 appear attached to query #2, etc. Payload and logs below.

ingrid: Repro payload (JSONL) — notice per_query candidates lengths:
```jsonl
{"queries": ["q1","q2","q3"], "candidates": [["a","b","c"],["d","e"],["f","g","h"]]}
```

ingrid: Response had 3 scores for q2, 2 for q1 — seems like an off-by-one pairing when candidates arrays are uneven.

sam: Can you paste the exact request id + timestamp? Also content-type and content-length headers?

ingrid: request-id: r-0a9f3b, ts: 1741112218. Headers: Content-Type: application/jsonl, Content-Encoding: gzip, x-sdk-version: rerank-js@2.1.0

alex: Hmm gzip chunking + JSONL boundaries have bitten us before :grimacing:. Any chance the client is sending a trailing newline or extra separator?

maria: @ingrid can you try the same payload with Content-Encoding omitted (send plain JSONL) — that'll tell if compression reassembly is misplacing boundaries.

ingrid: Tried that — plain JSONL gives correct alignments. With gzip we see the shift. Attached server log snippet:
```
[runtime] parse_batch_rows start
[runtime] per_query_counts parsed: [3,2,3]
[runtime] flattened_candidates length: 8
[runtime] pairing loop i=0..7 -> assign to queries using rolling offset -> result counts [2,3,3]
```

sam: That log suggests we might be reading the compressed stream wrong and losing a zero-length separator or extra byte.

maria: Repro script (py):
```python
import requests, gzip
payload = b'{"queries":["q1","q2","q3"],"candidates":[["a","b","c"],["d","e"],["f","g","h"]]}\n'
compressed = gzip.compress(payload)
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank/batch', data=compressed, headers={'Content-Type':'application/jsonl','Content-Encoding':'gzip'})
print(resp.json())
```

alex: If that repros locally we should open an eng-runtime ticket. Can you capture a pcap or save the exact gzip bytes so eng can inspect boundary bytes?

ingrid: Saved the gzip blob to s3: s3://support-repro/finderco/1741112218.gz — shared with eng. For now, as temporary workaround I told the customer to send without gzip. They need it for large payloads though.

support-bot: :white_check_mark: Support ticket #SUP-4921 created and linked to customer FinderCo. Escalation level: P2.

sam: Add note to include SDK version. Is this limited to rerank batch only or other endpoints? @maria

maria: Initial check shows only batch rerank codepath touched the flattening/zipper code. We'll triage in eng-runtime tomorrow. I've set a canary job to test different chunk sizes.

ingrid: Also noticed a client that sends multiple JSON objects in one gzip stream (no newlines) — that definitely confuses our parser. Added that to repro notes.

alex: Thanks. Next steps: eng-runtime to reproduce with provided gzip blob, add unit test for compressed streams, then patch parser to respect explicit per-query counts rather than rely on streaming offsets.

maria: I'll update the customer with ETA: we'll follow up after triage (~24h). :thumbsup:

ingrid: Thanks — keeping this thread updated.
